OCR: PNG image extraction with OCR enabled. In WASM this exercises the Uint8Array bridge parameter and Promise await in the generated OcrBackend bridge.

```elixir title="Elixir"
input_value = %Xberg.ExtractInput{bytes: :binary.bin_to_list(File.read!("images/test_hello_world.png")), config: %{}, filename: "test_hello_world.png", kind: "bytes", mime_type: "image/png"}
result = Xberg.extract_async(input_value, "{}")
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.results, 0).content)
```
